Kunal vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ?Court No. - 74

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12716 of 2023
Applicant :- Kunal

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohit Gautam
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Mohit Gautam, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B.Maurya, learned AGA-I,
for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.399 of 2022,under Sections 376 and 323 IPC, Police Station Gonda,
District Aligarh during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and three others under Sections 376 and 323 IPC and according to the FIR, applicant committed rape with the informant under the false promise of marriage.
It is further mentioned in the FIR that the victim/informant is still residing at the house of applicant but his family members harassed her.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the victim/informant is herself deponent in the present matter and she is major girl and she performed marriage with applicant according to her own wish on 1.11.2022 and after marriage they started living as husband and wife but unfortunately some dispute arose between them and in anger the victim, who is the deponent of the present bail application, lodged FIR of the present case.
Kunal vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96666461/
1 5.

He further submits that now both the parties have compromised the matter and victim, who is the informant and deponent herself of the present matter has also realized her mistake and she wants to live with applicant and she is having no objection if applicant be enlarged on bail and the fact of compromise has specifically been averred by the deponent, who is also victim of the case in paragraph-12 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.
6. He next submits that applicant in the present matter is in jail since 30.1.2023.

7. Per contra, learned AGA although opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that the victim/informant is herself deponent in the present matter and in paragraph-12 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application she specifically stated that she had entered into a compromise with applicant and in paragraph nos.10,11 and 12 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application she also admitted this fact that she had performed marriage with applicant.
8.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. It is the unique case in which victim/informant of the case, is deponent in the present bail application and it appears from the FIR that under the pretext of false marriage applicant sexually exploited the victim/informant but from the perusal of paragraph nos.10,11 and 12 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application, it appears that the victim/informant had performed marriage with the applicant and both victim/informant , i.e., deponent of the case and applicant were residing happily as husband and wife but from the perusal of paragraph-12 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application it appears that some dispute arose between them and,
therefore, the deponent lodged FIR in the present matter and now they have settled their dispute and deponent wants to live with the applicant as his wife.
10. Therefore, from the discussions made above, in my view,applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
11. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

12. Let the applicant-Kunal be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.

Kunal vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96666461/
2 13.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 20.4.2023 SKM  Kunal vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96666461/
